messages:
sarah.ops: 🚨 Incident: multiple EU customers reporting 5xxs and 300-800ms tail latency after automated failover at 08:13 UTC. Investigating.
raj.eng: seeing elevated 502/504 rates in EU app gateway logs, spike at 08:13:22. Any config changes around then?
deploy-bot: deploy completed: autoscaler-policy update on routing-controller at 08:12:58 by raj.eng
sarah.ops: note: affected customers primarily eu-west and eu-central. Some reports also show auth token failures (401) after retries.
tina.sre: pulling service-discovery logs now. Early theory: fallback routing went to ap-south-1 due to capacity-tag mismatch, causing cross-region latency and token cache misses.
alex.support: multiple customer threads: slow responses causing client-side retries. One customer reported duplicate invoice line items after 3 retry attempts.
emma.prod: billing alert triggered for unusual retry multiplier. Could retries have triggered duplicate billing events?
raj.eng: repro steps (local):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -H "X-Region-Pref: eu"
# response headers show X-Served-Region: ap-south-1
# logs show routing-controller matched region tag 'eu' -> fallback group 'eu-burst' -> ap-south-1
```
sarah.ops: timeline so far: 08:12:58 autoscaler-policy deploy -> 08:13:05 health-check flapping -> 08:13:22 controller re-routes -> 08:13:23 large number of cross-region requests -> 08:14:10 downstream auth cache misses -> 08:15 customer escalations
tina.sre: log snippet from routing-controller:
```
WARN routing: unable to find capacity for eu-burst, matching fallback policy=region-tag-similarity
INFO routing: selected candidate region=ap-south-1 (score=0.67)
ERROR auth-proxy: token-cache-miss for tenant=acme-corp
```
raj.eng: root cause hypothesis: the new autoscaler-policy change inadvertently changed the fallback priority list and a tag normalization bug considered 'eu' similar to 'ap-south' because of truncated region code match. That plus capacity calculation flagged eu pools as full and initiated wrong fallback.
emma.prod: impact summary requested: number of requests affected, customers with billing anomalies, duration of elevated latency.
alex.support: preliminary customer impact: ~12 paid accounts reported increased latency and 3 reported duplicate billing lines. Support mitigations: refunded duplicates, advised token refresh for 401s.
billing-bot: billing-run anomaly flagged: 2026-03-09T08:16:00: duplicate charge attempt count +2 for 3 customers. Investigating.
tina.sre: mitigation applied at 08:19:00: rolled back autoscaler-policy change and forced re-evaluation of fallback priorities. Also added temp route pin for eu customers to eu-primary. Health stabilized by 08:21:30.
raj.eng: post-mortem action items:
- revert fallback normalization logic (PR#452)
- add unit test for region-tag similarity
- improve canary for autoscaler-policy (shorter, synthetic traffic)
- add a rate-limiter on retry billing event ingestion
emma.prod: add customer communication draft: apology, root cause summary, mitigation, and refunds for duplicate lines. ETA for communication: EOD.
sarah.ops: for the postmortem doc — include exact repro steps, logs above, affected tenants, timeline, mitigation, long-term fixes, and follow-ups assigned.
alex.support: saved list of affected accounts in #support-ops. Will attach to postmortem.
raj.eng: quick note on auth token misses: token cache TTL relied on region-local cache. Cross-region auth proxy didn't have the cached entry so first request failed 401 then succeeded on refresh. Fix: ensure token sync or grace on fallback for token validation.
emma.prod: proposed communication snippet: "We experienced an automated routing fallback that incorrectly routed some EU traffic to another region, causing higher latency and in rare cases duplicate billing lines due to retry logic. We rolled back the change and refunded affected customers."
sarah.ops: status: incident resolved at 08:21:30 UTC. Preparing full postmortem. Thanks all for fast triage :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: incident-ticket updated: INCIDENT-20260309-42, status=resolved, severity=P2
sarah.ops: tagging owners: raj.eng (routing), tina.sre (mitigation), emma.prod (customer comms), alex.support (billing refunds). Will schedule postmortem doc review tomorrow 16:00 UTC.
